item.title: Aero HTB Writeup
item.description: Aero is a medium-difficulty Windows machine featuring two recent CVEs: CVE-2023-38146, affecting Windows 11 themes, and CVE-2023-28252, targeting the Common Log File System (CLFS). Initial access is achieved through the crafting of a malicious payload using the ThemeBleed proof-of-concept, resulting in a reverse shell. Upon gaining a foothold, a CVE disclosure notice is found in the user's home directory, indicating vulnerability to CVE-2023-28252. Modification of an existing proof-of-concept is required to facilitate privilege escalation to administrator level or code execution as NT Authority/SYSTEM.

item.title: Secnotes HTB Writeup
item.description: SecNotes is a medium difficulty machine, which highlights the risks associated with weak password change mechanisms, lack of CSRF protection and insufficient validation of user input. It also teaches about Windows Subsystem for Linux enumeration.

About Our bi0s Pentest Blog

Welcome to the bi0s Pentest blog! We are cybersecurity professionals dedicated to sharing knowledge, techniques, and insights about the field of penetration testing and cybersecurity.

Our Mission

Our mission is to:

  • Share practical knowledge about penetration testing techniques
  • Raise awareness about cybersecurity best practices
  • Create a community of security-minded professionals and enthusiasts
  • Provide valuable resources for those looking to enter or advance in the field

Our Team

Our team consists of experienced penetration testers, security researchers, and cybersecurity enthusiasts who are passionate about the field and committed to continuous learning and knowledge sharing.
